headline: VíasChile Submits $456 Million Expansion Project for Ruta 5 Norte
summary: Toll operator VíasChile submitted a $456 million highway expansion project for the Ruta 5 Norte corridor, featuring fourth lanes and free-flow tolling scheduled for construction starting March 2029.
why: Concession road infrastructure investments reflect long-term capital deployment and municipal transport planning across Chile.

impacts.name: VíasChile
impacts.why: Entered a $456 million infrastructure investment application for major highway upgrades.
